rules: Ontology and gateway do not implement or certify safety functions.
A process command, safety observation and safety-control action have distinct types and authorities.
Unknown or stale safety observations never mean safe.
Reset and restart are distinct; no inferred automatic restart.
Route release and zone permission are operational coordination, not safety clearance.
review_required: Licensed ISO 3691-4 clauses and site applicability
Hazard analysis, protective measures and verification evidence
Responsible safety engineer and execution owner
Applicable regional legislation and later standard revisions
